resources.title: Artifact completeness and verified delivery
resources.summary: Reconcile complete deliverables, dependency closure, actual output revisions and authorized destination readback before claiming handoff.
useWhen: Multi-file packages, standalone components, archives, asset sets or saved catalog revisions must be delivered.
Import, upload, publication or stale-output complaints require exact target/version and completeness evidence.
avoidWhen: The task is explanation-only with no artifact or delivery requirement.
A format owner still needs to validate the content; packaging alone cannot replace that work.

resources.title: Browser evidence and website extraction
resources.summary: Ground reconstruction and UI repair in identified source versions, asset dependencies and comparable rendered/interactive states.
useWhen: The task extracts, rebuilds or diagnoses an existing website or browser interface.
Saved HTML/assets, screenshots, live page behaviour or browser-only failures are evidence.
avoidWhen: The task is a public factual lookup with no need to interact with a page.
A native application is the target and the available browser cannot observe it.

resources.title: Structured content and technical SEO
resources.summary: Build and migrate source-grounded content collections with real destinations, preserved approved copy, coherent presentation and validated metadata/schema.
useWhen: Markdown/MDX content, seo.yaml/schema.yaml, article migrations or generated service pages are in scope.
Canonical URLs, sitemaps, redirects, internal links or structured-data output are affected.
avoidWhen: The task requests only general marketing strategy with no implementation or content artefact.

resources.title: Database schemas and data integrity
resources.summary: Apply engine-specific checks to migrations, queries, tenant access, locks and data compatibility.
useWhen: SQL/schema changes, query behaviour, data access rules or database performance are in scope.
A migration, import, restore or concurrency issue can affect persisted data.
avoidWhen: The change is purely presentational and does not alter data access.

resources.title: Shared design systems, typography and presets
resources.summary: Maintain canonical components, tokens, fonts, icons and saved visual presets consistently across consumers and interaction states.
useWhen: Shared sections, design tokens, typography systems, icon libraries or component catalogs change.
Theme/accent/font controls, per-section overrides or reusable HTML exports need consistent styling and persistence.
avoidWhen: An isolated illustration has no shared system or consumer contract.
The task changes only local copy and does not need new theme/catalog infrastructure.

resources.title: Editors, registries and persistent schemas
resources.summary: Preserve native widget models, nested editability, preset inheritance and persistent tree/configuration semantics across every editor surface.
useWhen: A visual editor, page builder, structured tree, widget registry or saved workspace is changing.
Document schemas, settings persistence, selection, undo/redo or import/export contracts are involved.
avoidWhen: The page is a static presentation with no editable document model.

resources.title: Image art direction and consistent asset production
resources.summary: Direct authorized image generation/editing with source-locked composition, consistent geometry and semantically distinct product concepts.
useWhen: Product renders, hero/CTA imagery, consistent asset families or precise reference-image edits are requested.
Multiple image concepts or variants need shared-base invariants, meaningful differences and a reconciled output set.
avoidWhen: An exact chart/technical diagram needs deterministic geometry or factual data.
The task implements raster-to-vector conversion rather than generating/editing visual art.

resources.title: Infrastructure and deployment configuration
resources.summary: Ground infrastructure changes in provider versions, actual state, execution mode and recovery evidence.
useWhen: Server/container configuration, infrastructure as code, CI deployment or runtime operations are changing.
Networking, secrets, storage, provisioning or service health affect the requested result.
avoidWhen: The task is only application UI/content work with no infrastructure impact.

resources.title: Media libraries, archive ingestion and local conversion
resources.summary: Extend existing media-workspace navigation, imports, storage and conversion while preserving identity, privacy and measurable fidelity.
useWhen: An HTML/image/icon library, nested ZIP importer, media tree/gallery or large asset workflow changes.
Local conversion, native-pixel comparison, source/preview mapping or media loading performance is a requirement.
avoidWhen: The task creates visual art rather than library/conversion behavior.
A simple one-file export does not involve app integration, ingestion or asset lifecycle.

resources.title: Migration, recovery and release completion
resources.summary: Resume interrupted work from real source and task evidence, preserve milestones and reconcile the requested repository/package/release outcome.
useWhen: The task resumes a stalled build, migrates systems, recovers missing work or completes a release.
Local files, branches, commits, remote repositories or packaged versions disagree.
avoidWhen: There is no migration/release/recovery scope and a normal implementation stage suffices.

resources.title: Motion, interactive widgets and temporal verification
resources.summary: Model and verify meaningful animation sequences, transitions, controls and theme-dependent states over a complete relevant cycle.
useWhen: Animated hero widgets, terminals, maps, carousels, tab cycles or transition defects are in scope.
Pacing, flashing, jumping, barely visible state changes, playback controls or preview clutter affect the requested result.
avoidWhen: The target is static imagery with no temporal behavior.
Only realtime session/resource ownership is involved; use realtime-native.

resources.title: Native YAML and archive conversion
resources.summary: Map supplied HTML and the current kit to genuinely editable native widgets, presets and complete import packages with explicit custom-code exceptions.
useWhen: A supplied native YAML kit or receiving editor contract governs conversion of HTML, design-system sections or structured bundles.
Editable cards/products/tabs, preset variables, custom-code restrictions or archive/import compatibility are acceptance requirements.
avoidWhen: Only a static screenshot or prose explanation is needed.
No receiving schema/import contract can be obtained; report the gap before claiming compatible native output.

resources.title: Plugins, skills and MCP applications
resources.summary: Evolve plugin instructions, routers and tool/host contracts from evidence while preserving identity, explicit scope, compatibility and release provenance.
useWhen: A plugin, skill catalogue, command router, MCP server or ChatGPT app is being built or changed.
Tool descriptors, manifests, widget bridges or native-host contracts affect the requested behaviour.
avoidWhen: The task only invokes an existing plugin to perform unrelated application work.
No plugin, tool or host integration is in the actual scope.

resources.title: Python automation and data pipelines
resources.summary: Build resumable data processing with validated inputs, explicit failures and reconciled outputs.
useWhen: Python scripts, API ingestion, scraping outputs, transformations or automation pipelines are changing.
Pagination, retries, checkpoints, data contracts or partial failure affect correctness.
avoidWhen: The project has no Python/data-processing component.

resources.title: React and frontend systems
resources.summary: Apply the existing workflow to React interfaces, reusable components, responsive behaviour and frontend performance.
useWhen: React or Next.js components, application routes, state-driven UI or frontend regressions are in scope.
Shared design tokens, component APIs or rendering performance affect the requested change.
avoidWhen: The task is only static content conversion with no React runtime.

resources.title: Realtime media and native application lifecycles
resources.summary: Trace message identity, delivery/history, hidden/popout views and shared media ownership through the actual realtime or native runtime.
useWhen: The actual repository uses realtime chat/media, WebRTC, streaming or multi-window state.
A native macOS application or SwiftUI/AppKit bridge is explicitly part of the task.
avoidWhen: A device mentioned in conversation is only the user's computer, not the project target.
The task is static frontend work with no realtime or native lifecycle.

resources.title: Reference fidelity and precise corrections
resources.summary: Preserve approved source identity, constrain changes to requested deltas and verify observable results without collateral redesign.
useWhen: The task reconstructs or adapts supplied HTML, images, screenshots or approved artifacts.
Specific corrections, reference-locked variants or repeated complaints require an item-level delta and preservation checks.
avoidWhen: No reference/preservation requirement affects the change.
The user explicitly requests free exploration; do not impose pixel matching without a source contract.

resources.title: UI Design Director
resources.summary: Apply scoped visual corrections and a coherent design direction to every relevant UI task, with complete target review and evidence of visible quality.
useWhen: The actual request creates, changes, reconstructs, reviews or improves a user-visible layout, design, typography, palette, spacing, component presentation, visual asset or motion.
A contextual follow-up asks for visual improvement or corrects prior output, including brief feedback without explicit UI keywords.
A mixed engineering task changes user-facing presentation; apply this lens only to the relevant part and preserve the selected stage boundary.
avoidWhen: The actual task is nonvisual backend, data, infrastructure or source analysis; incidental UI vocabulary does not establish visual scope.
Only a selector or a bare invocation with no recoverable task context is present; identify the actual task before assigning work.

resources.title: Usage evidence and workflow improvement
resources.summary: Analyze complete task evidence with deduplication and outcome limits, map demand to current capabilities and evaluate bounded plugin improvements.
useWhen: Usage exports, agent traces or repeated feedback are supplied to improve plugins, skills, routers or workflows.
Existing-versus-missing capability analysis and prioritized evidence-grounded instruction changes are requested.
avoidWhen: The request is ordinary task execution or one local correction already owned by a domain stage.
Unrelated personal-history discovery is not needed or authorized for the current request.

resources.title: WHMCS modules and client-area systems
resources.summary: Assess and implement WHMCS extensions with verified hook contracts, lifecycle and account boundaries.
useWhen: The task changes a WHMCS addon, hook, client-area template, API integration or account workflow.
Rate limits, billing/account behaviour or module lifecycle depends on WHMCS.
avoidWhen: The task affects only WordPress/WooCommerce or generic PHP, with no WHMCS integration.
Only marketing-page copy changes and no WHMCS integration is affected.

resources.title: WordPress and WooCommerce
resources.summary: Use WordPress and commerce-specific lifecycle, data, permissions and compatibility checks.
useWhen: A WordPress theme, plugin, block, REST integration or WooCommerce extension is in scope.
Content storage, custom checkout/order behaviour or PHP/JavaScript integration depends on WordPress.
avoidWhen: Only WHMCS is affected; there is no WordPress/WooCommerce component or integration.
The project has no WordPress runtime or compatibility requirement.

resources.title: Assess Codebase
resources.summary: Trace relevant entry points, ownership, conventions and tests; record sources and unknowns. No application edits.

resources.title: Consult Architecture
resources.summary: Write an ADR and implementation boundaries; no source edits.

resources.title: Design UI
resources.summary: Read real design tokens and components; produce a UI specification and interaction states only.

resources.title: Diagnose Root Cause
resources.summary: Reproduce and trace a bug or failure before any fix. Writes hypotheses, evidence, and confirmed cause.

resources.title: Repository Contribution Scout
resources.summary: Repository-wide contribution discovery, source-grounded roadmap and PR plans (read-only).

resources.title: Execute Approved Plan
resources.summary: Apply approved plan against current reviewed revision. Preserve scope, checkpoints and evidence.

resources.title: Extract Existing Behaviour
resources.summary: Extract observed behaviour and invariants from code, without guessing or changing application source.

resources.title: Fix Reviewed Defects
resources.summary: Apply only separately authorised actionable findings; do not self-authorise scope changes.

resources.title: Plan Code Changes
resources.summary: Create file- and test-specific implementation steps, in the same record; does not execute.

resources.title: Plan Goals
resources.summary: Decompose authorised outcomes into dependencies, constraints and acceptance criteria; no implementation.

resources.title: Plan Tests Only
resources.summary: Define assertions, fixtures and required RED/GREEN checks without writing or running tests.

resources.title: Research Technical Options
resources.summary: Compare libraries or technical approaches with verified sources; never implement.

resources.title: Review Accessibility
resources.summary: Assess keyboard, focus, semantics and responsive interaction with reproducible evidence; no automatic UI changes.

resources.title: Review Code
resources.summary: Review diff with evidence; reviewer cannot implement its own suggested changes.

resources.title: Review Dependency Risk
resources.summary: Review new package choices, provenance, licenses and supply-chain exposure. Does not install dependencies.

resources.title: Review Plan
resources.summary: Review requirement coverage, execution feasibility and plan revision. Does not implement.

resources.title: Review Security
resources.summary: Bounded independent static/runtime security verification; report defects without expanding privileges.

resources.title: Review Visual Fidelity
resources.summary: Compare rendered UI to existing design or approved UI spec, with screenshot evidence.

resources.title: Review UI Specification
resources.summary: Check design contract for implementability, consistency, responsive behaviour and ownership; independent review.

resources.title: Run End-to-End Tests
resources.summary: Run current browser journeys and capture screenshots/traces; never run build first.

resources.title: Run Tests & Validation
resources.summary: Run existing build/lint/typecheck/unit/integration commands; capture exits and logs without feature implementation.

resources.title: Update Documentation
resources.summary: Update affected docs from real code diff; do not rebuild source code.

resources.title: Verify Documentation
resources.summary: Check each documentation claim and command against actual code.

resources.title: Verify Delivered Goals
resources.summary: Confirm observable outcomes and requirements, rather than only counting tasks.

resources.title: Verify Performance
resources.summary: Verified performance evidence only.

resources.title: Write Failing Tests
resources.summary: Write tests, capture expected RED assertion, and refuse to treat infrastructure errors as RED.

limitations: Search returns explainable candidates; it does not select a workflow, grant authority, dispatch workers or prove semantic applicability.
Refine the request query with inspected project evidence when ownership, stack or impact is initially unknown.
A recorded instruction path cannot prove that a model intellectually read or applied it; independent review checks the effect.
